dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: The skill contains many deep CloudWatch specifics (detection‑lag baselines, composite rule length limits, anomaly‑detector warm‑up, action ordering effects, cross‑account metric nuances). However, several points (TreatMissingData default, DatapointsToAlarm ≤ EvaluationPeriods, basic alarm creation flags) are already well‑known to a capable model, so the added delta is strong but not maximal.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific workflow: deterministic pre‑checks (namespace, dimensions, period alignment, IAM), snapshot before any state‑changing CLI, mandatory CONFIRM gate, exact flag ordering for put‑metric‑alarm/put‑composite‑alarm, and post‑verification steps. Only a few generic phrasings remain.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Comprehensive NEVER list with concrete reasons (TreatMissingData default, DatapointsToAlarm > EvaluationPeriods, action duplication, etc.). Missing an explicit warning about using static thresholds on high‑variance metrics without sampling, so a minor deduction.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description, when_to_use, activation_triggers, and invocation_schema are present. Activation triggers include a few vague entries (e.g., "composite alarm") that could cause ambiguous activation.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Content is layered: quick reference first, then mindset, pre‑flight, process, common patterns, diagnostics, output format, anti‑patterns, safety checks, and recent features. Critical rules are not buried; the top‑level gives just enough to act, deeper details on demand.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive operations are tightly constrained (pre‑checks, confirm gate, snapshot) while planning/diagnostic steps are freer. Calibration matches the fragility of each task.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows the established CloudOps skill pattern: quick navigation table, mindset, pre‑flight, process, common patterns, diagnostics, output format, anti‑patterns, safety checklist. Structure is coherent and recognizable.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete CLI commands, decision trees, verification steps, and worked examples enabling an agent to execute the skill. Lacks explicit handling of CLI failures and automated rollback on post‑verify failure, which slightly reduces robustness.
